cyberattack: Bypassing bot protection or access controls
data.description:
Building on Francisco’s #55 and Daniel’s #96, we verified two additional campaign-finance PDFs in the May 26, 2026 CAL-ACCESS captures:

  - R&V Management Corporation — filing 2933098.
  - R.J. Reynolds Tobacco Company — filing 2933863.

Both were retrieved using the same modified URL pattern, bringing the total to three distinct public filings. This strengthens the evidence that the known bot-protection workaround succeeded repeatedly.
data.summary: Verified 2 additional CAL-ACCESS campaign-finance PDFs retrieved on May 26, 2026 using the same URL workaround. This brings the total to three distinct filings.
